description: The signed base envelope every Hypermedia CBOR blob extends: a `type` tag (the discriminator the network dispatches on), the signer's public key, an Ed25519 signature over the canonical CBOR with the signature zeroed, and a unix-millisecond timestamp. Change, Ref, Profile, Comment, Capability and Contact all extend it — and so can your own types: extend this schema, pin a `type` tag, and the app signs values with your account.
name: Signed blob
